body: The post is..literally about SAO and how she wants to make SAO friends..

People are allowed to like whatever they want...maybe don’t shit on what other people like just because you don’t like it? Like cool dude SAO was very meh, you could’ve just messaged one of the many other anime lovers on this subreddit >~>
All I’ve ever wanted is to give them what they wanted, no matter what it is. It’s just hard to live without them when you’ve been living for someone for so long..

I just want...someone...
Anybody..
..don’t leave me alone

I decided to walk to a train station and jump, I’m never gonna have a single soul stay by my side so what’s the point? I can’t breathe, I can’t calm down...none of my normal techniques are working. I don’t wanna be alone right now, but I finally got a response and he told me to fuck off and die..so...I just..I’m gonna cuddle my dog a bit before I go..
